breaking_news.headline: How the beverage aisle got so wild
breaking_news.summary: Planet Money traced many new beverage flavors to one laboratory that serves dozens of companies to see how new flavors are created and why we're seeing such an explosion of options right now.

breaking_news.headline: Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety
breaking_news.summary: The three fired workers say OpenAI punished them for being outspoken about safety. The company disputes the claims and says they were fired over mishandling sensitive information.

breaking_news.headline: Kalshi taps former FBI agent to fight against money laundering
breaking_news.summary: The prediction market company says it wants to prevent its platform from being abused by criminals. The company is facing mounting pressure over market manipulation and insider trading on the site.

breaking_news.headline: It's taking longer to find a new job after losing one
breaking_news.summary: People who lose their jobs in this economy are taking longer to find new work. Nearly four in ten people exhaust their unemployment benefits before they land a new job.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Department investigates TV networks, citing possible anti-trust violations
breaking_news.summary: The move escalates Trump's fight with the press amid court battle over barring CNN, Politico and MS NOW from the White House.

breaking_news.headline: 2 Americans win Nobel Prize in economics for work on boom-bust cycles
breaking_news.summary: Two Americans have won the Nobel Prize in economics for their work on how to smooth boom-and-bust cycles to limit unemployment and inflation.

breaking_news.headline: Farmers say they'll take the relief of Trump's EO — but they're still hurting
breaking_news.summary: President Trump says his Monday executive order temporarily suspending federal taxes on diesel will be a big relief for farmers. Some farmers call it a campaign ploy with marginal impact.

breaking_news.headline: What ice cream has to do with this year's Nobel Prize in economics
breaking_news.summary: Prices can get sticky. That helps explain why recessions hurt so much — and what policymakers can do about them.

breaking_news.headline: Ex-president named leader of new DR Congo rebel coalition
breaking_news.summary: Joseph Kabila had previously denied having links to the M23 rebels, which control much of eastern DR Congo.

breaking_news.headline: Super El Niño sets another record as it strengthens to 'unprecedented levels'
breaking_news.summary: El Niño has continued to strengthen, with several key measures now in record territory. Simon King explores how it compares to previous events.

breaking_news.headline: Hungarian MPs scrap Orbán's anti-LGBTQ measures
breaking_news.summary: LGBTQ and human rights activists warmly welcomed the move, but call for changes to other Orbán-era laws.

breaking_news.headline: Bulgaria summons Russian ambassador after ship sinks in Black Sea drone attack
breaking_news.summary: Six crew members are rescued but 10 are missing after a merchant ship was sunk overnight, Bulgaria says.

breaking_news.headline: Watch: Emergency calls from botched Christa Pike execution released
breaking_news.summary: A series of calls, obtained by the Associated Press, reveal emergency services were delayed in reaching Pike.

breaking_news.headline: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
breaking_news.summary: Mitte, who lived with cerebral palsy, starred as Walter White Jr in the Emmy-winning drama series.

breaking_news.headline: Horrified witnesses recount fatal rollercoaster incident at Six Flags
breaking_news.summary: One person is dead and others were injured after an incident at the amusement park in the US state of Georgia.

breaking_news.headline: Russia's offensive ability is broken, Kyiv's former top general tells BBC
breaking_news.summary: In his first interview since being forced from his post, Gen Syrskyi speaks about Ukraine's future in the war.

breaking_news.headline: Phase Eight and Hobbs owner hit by cyber-attack, as H&M probes separate hack claim
breaking_news.summary: TFG London has apologised to customers for disruption after it identified a "cybersecurity incident" on Sunday.

breaking_news.headline: The Sabrina Carpenter clip which helped a 22-year-old make £120,000 a year
breaking_news.summary: Social media "clippers" make short, vertical videos that appear on the likes of Instagram and TikTok.

breaking_news.headline: UK growth forecast upgraded but higher energy prices to hit economy next year
breaking_news.summary: The prediction from the IMF comes as final preparations are being made for the first Budget under Prime Minister Andy Burnham.

breaking_news.headline: Heating oil customers face tough winter despite shake-up promise
breaking_news.summary: Heating oil customers facing soaring bills are promised better regulation of the sector by the government.
